# Synthetic hand histories

These files are written by hand to exercise a parser: they are **not** real hand histories and they
contain no real player. A parser that only has synthetic samples is a first version: it needs real
samples from the room before it can be trusted (see `ROADMAP_PROGRESS.md`).

| File | Room | Why synthetic |
|---|---|---|
| `pokerstars_spin_and_go.txt` | PokerStars (Spin & Go) | Written from the documented PokerStars layout. |
| `ggpoker_spin_gold.txt` | GGPoker (Spin Gold) | Written from the documented layout; the header is the least certain part. |
| `ipoker_spin.xml` | iPoker network (also PMU Twister) | Written from the documented XML layout. |
